topic.title: Your feed is your character certificate
topic.claim: Before a family meets a girl, they've read her Instagram like a case file, and the verdict gets harsher for her than for the boy.
topic.behaviour: Families screen prospective brides through their Instagram, flagging bikini photos, parties and drinking, while excusing the groom's own habits.
topic.mechanism: The profile is treated as proof of real character, and reputation is still handled as a family asset. The double standard hides in the fact that nobody audits the boy's feed.
topic.group: families and singles in the arranged-marriage market
real_details: A relative flagged that a girl's Instagram was full of bikini pics and party posts
A friend of the brother followed her, which started the family's 'IG analysis'
Her drinking and smoking were cited, though the brother said he was fine with it
The poster ended up asking if anyone does arranged marriage willingly
topic.why_now: A top-of-month thread shows how openly families now do Instagram due diligence.

score.reason: Strong mirror, named group, real gendered double standard, fresh framing.
score.best_hook: Before any family meets a girl, they've already read her Instagram like a case file. Nobody ever opens the boy's.
